card.name: The before US East Coast place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (mostly "the", also "from", "to", "into", "of") right before an expected eastern US place name such as Chesapeake or Atlantic. Seen in geography, wildlife and fishing text.

modes.label: The before a region
modes.description: The word "the" just before an expected East Coast water body or region.
modes.example: Nearly all striped bass found in Vineyard waters come from<< the>> Chesapeake.

modes.label: Direction or movement words
modes.description: Words like "from", "to", "into" after verbs of travel or spread, before an East Coast place.
modes.example: continuing north<< to>> Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville,

card.writes: It pushes up East Coast names like Delaware, Maryland, Baltimore and Chesapeake, and pushes down West Coast names like Pacific, California and Oregon.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before the text names an East Coast place like the Chesapeake or the Atlantic.
